reviews.text: Rey is a phenomenal groomer!! He is incredibly sweet, professional, knowledgeable and a true animal lover. I can’t recommend him enough. Thank you so much Rey! You’re the best. 10/10

Very disappointing experience with Tito's Dog Grooming. I would NOT trust them with my dogs again.

Their pricing is completely inconsistent. They tell you one price and then come up with additional charges — teeth, knots, extra grooming, etc. One time they tell you knots cost extra, another time they say that if the dog has knots they have to shave him. It always seems to be a different story and a different price.

I was also extremely unhappy with the way they cut my dogs' hair. On top of that, my dogs have come back visibly scared and nervous, which makes me very uncomfortable and concerned about bringing them there again.

The customer service was just as disappointing. I called specifically to complain and explain my concerns, and I was basically ignored. No proper response, no attempt to address the problem, nothing.

Poor grooming, inconsistent pricing, lack of transparency, and terrible customer service. In my experience, Tito's Dog Grooming was very unprofessional and unreliable.

My recommendation is to take your dogs somewhere smaller or to a family-run groomer where you can get more personal attention. My experience here left me feeling that the focus was much more on charging for additional services than on making me feel that my dogs were genuinely cared for.

Poor grooming, inconsistent pricing, lack of transparency, and terrible customer service. I will definitely not be bringing my dogs back.
Excellent service

I wanted to thank César Villarroel for his excellent and attentive professionalism.

Thank you

Absolutely phenomenal! Titos dog grooming mobile service has exceeded all my expectations. From the moment they arrive every time, its clear that they truly care about providing a top-notch experience for both the pets and their owners. All the groomers we have had the pleasure deal with (Jonathan, Eduardo, Georlady, Maribel) have been incredibly professional, friendly, and patient with my anxious pup.

The convenience of having them come to my home cannot be overstated. It eliminated the stress of transporting my dog to a grooming salon and allowed him to feel comfortable in a familiar environment. The van was spotless and fully equipped with everything needed for a thorough and pampering grooming session.

My dog has never looked better! Her coat is shiny and  she smells amazing. The groomers even take the time to address her major shedding and gave me excellent advice on maintaining her coat between appointments.

What truly sets this service apart is the personal touch and genuine love for animals. Lotus was treated with such care and gentleness, and it was clear that the groomer is passionate about their work. They even sent progress pictures 😍 I highly recommend this mobile dog grooming service to any pet owner looking for a convenient, stress-free, and top-quality grooming experience. Five stars all the way!
My little chicken nugget loves Maribel, she's extremely gentle and kind! Shes highly skilled with great attention to detail! You cant go wrong booking her!!!

Love their services. Very professional,  flexible with scheduling, great prices and awesome customer service. I  would definitely recommend them to anyone.
Armando is very professional and patient with our dogs.
Jonathan did an amazing job with my golden boy. 100% recommend!
Excellent service

Thank you!!! I'm so happy! My dog ​​Wasabi is 12 years old, he had cancer, he's a very spoiled dog, and he was so well-behaved. When I got him back, he looked so beautiful!!! He smelled amazing! His nails were trimmed, and he was well-groomed! ♥️🥰😘 Thank you!!! I give you 100%! 🐶🤗 …
Incredible as always 🫶😊
Excellent service! Edwin was very kind and thorough. He worked wonders with my 17-year-old pet. He took excellent care of her and I highly recommend him.

Jonathan was awesome! Definitely an expert handler.

We have a ~150 lb Presa Canario named Zelda who can be very protective and nervous around new people. We started with her wearing a muzzle because we weren't sure how she'd react to someone new getting up close and personal with her. She was really anxious at first, but Jonathan was incredibly patient and quickly got her comfortable enough that he was able to take the muzzle off.

You can tell Jonathan really knows how to read animal behavior and genuinely loves animals. He was patient, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience so much easier for both us and Zelda. She didn't bark a single time! By the end, you could actually tell she was enjoying herself and had completely warmed up to him.

Best dog grooming experience we've ever had. Thank you, Jonathan! We'll definitely see you at the next appointment.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had such a great experience with Daniel! He was extremely professional, patient, and really took his time with my dog, Blue. I’ve been to several different groomers, and Daniel has honestly been one of the best we’ve had. You can tell he genuinely cares about the dogs he works with and makes sure they’re comfortable throughout the grooming process.

Blue looked amazing, and I really appreciated the care and attention Daniel gave him. It’s not always easy finding someone you feel comfortable trusting with your fur baby, but Daniel definitely made me feel at ease. I will absolutely be requesting him again. Highly recommend! 🐶❤️✨
Jonathan was amazing. He did an excellent job on my puppies.
They do Great job with my dog!! Use them all the time!! Amazing people super nice and friendly to my dog, amazing work!!
The best! Rey is amazing !
Excellent service, 100% recommended
Armando did such a great job grooming my Westie! The cut came out perfect, and he looks so cute and well-groomed. 🐾🤍

I am beyond grateful for Jonathan at Tito Grooming. The minute I spoke to them they understood what I needed.  Nobu is my baby boy, and grooming has always been very stressful for him. He gets extremely anxious, and after having such a hard time finding someone who could actually take the time to understand him, I was honestly so nervous bringing him in.

Jonathan was incredible from the very beginning. He was patient, calm, gentle, and never rushed Nobu. He took his time with him and made sure he felt safe and comfortable. That alone meant everything to me.

When I saw Nobu after his grooming, I was so happy. He looked absolutely beautiful, but more importantly, I could tell he had been treated with love and patience.

Finding someone you trust with your fur baby is not easy, especially when they are anxious like Nobu. I can finally say I found his groomer for life. ❤️

Thank you so much, Jonathan, for taking such amazing care of my baby boy. You have a customer for life!
Luis did an amazing job on my puppy Yorkie Luna, who got groomed for the very first time! He was super friendly, asked what we wanted, and did exactly that! She looks adorable!

Eduardo  is the best groomer, amazing my dog loves him
He is allways on time and is very loving  with my dog pays attention to detail and genuine
We appreciate him very much
Thank you

Maribel did an amazing job grooming my dog! She gave him a thorough bath and grooming, cleaned his ears, and carefully cut and filed his nails. She is incredibly caring and detail-oriented, taking her time to make sure he feels comfortable and relaxed throughout the process. I really appreciated how she builds a trusting relationship with the dog. My dog looked fantastic when he was finished! I highly recommend Maribel from Tito's Dog Grooming for anyone looking for a caring and professional groomer.
Ray was so great! He did exactly what I asked for and was good with Charlie. I will definitely be calling on him again! Thank you Ray!💙
Today was Suchi’s turn again and Eduardo the groomer did a phenomenal job as usual!!! He is a gem. Too bad you only go up to 5 stars but I have decided to give him FIVE more. Great service!!!
I have been using Titis groomers for almost a year now, and they are great with my Schi zu.  Reliable, professional,  and on point with their appointments..

Excellent service! Daniel was very careful with my baby Abby. She came out happy and calm, smelling wonderful, and he even removed the matted fur. He was very professional and 100% recommended. Every time I want to bathe my dog, I'll call this company and Daniel to do it. I'm very happy with this service.

Extremely dangerous driving and unacceptable behavior.
This business van cut across traffic right in front of us, nearly causing a severe accident just to avoid missing their exit, putting everyone's lives on the line. I immediately started filming in shock at the reckless move, the driver spat at us and laughed as if endangering lives was a joke.
If this driver shows this much disregard for human safety and basic decency on the road, I can't imagine how they treat animals when no one is looking. Especially since they likely transport pets in that same van. Absolute lack of accountability, safety, and professionalism.

Eduardo GerardocRoballodid an amazing job grooming my dog! He was very professional, patient, and caring. My puppy looked beautiful, clean, and smelled amazing after the grooming. I’m very happy with the service and definitely recommend him!
The staff is really nice but my dog got traumatized, he never liked the grooming experience and after this grooming  it became impossible.
Excellent service! I've been looking for years for someone who knows how to groom my dog ​​properly, and I finally found them. Thank you for your service, Armando; you clearly love your job.
Armando was so nice and understood what I wanted. The dogs came back super happy and they look fabulous!

I've been going to Tito's Grooming for a couple of years now and I love it. Honestly, I wouldn't trust my daughter to anyone else! Highly recommended! 🫶🏽 …

No extra hidden fees after service. Armando was great. He kept me updated with pictures and explained to me what to get for aftercare. Will use this company again for convenience and quickness.

We have been using Tito's Dog Grooming for nearly a year now. The scheduling via text is very communicative and the service is great. Edwin is very kind and friendly with our 55lb pup! I would totally recommend!

I want to give a special thank you to Edwin for the excellent work he did with my dog. After a previous experience that left me dissatisfied, the company contacted me and sent Edwin to groom him again.

I was so happy with the result. Edwin is excellent at his job, very professional, careful, and it's clear he has a lot of experience. My dog ​​looked gorgeous! 🐶❤️

I also want to thank the company for listening to me, considering my concerns, and finally providing a solution.

I would definitely use the service again, but I would definitely hire Edwin again. 100% recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The Best Service in the Town , after use a lots service of grooming , this company is amazing!! Daniel is simply spectacular, he have everything you need for take care ours dogs , the dental services was perfect,  professional and friendly . My dog look more beatiful now !! I would recommend 100/ !!! Thanks you !!! Customer happy Toby and Smokey look

I absolutely loved how my girl turned out! 🐶💕 One of the most important things for me is knowing that she feels comfortable, calm, and safe with her groomer, and Eduardo is everything you could want for your pup!

He treated my girl with so much love and care, paid attention to every little detail, and did exactly what I asked for and even more. We did a full grooming, and he left her super fluffy just the way we love, cleaned up her face beautifully, took great care of her ears, and most importantly, treated her with so much love throughout the whole process.

If you’re looking for a groomer who will genuinely care for your pup, Mr. Eduardo is definitely the one! My girl came back happy, beautiful, and looking absolutely adorable. 🥹🐾💕 We’ll definitely be coming back!
